def generate(rng):
    h = rng.randint(6, 12)
    w = rng.randint(6, 12)
    g = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    # Sparse distractor marks, with one special marker (6) whose location defines output.
    cr = rng.randint(1, h-2)
    cc = rng.randint(1, w-2)
    g[cr][cc] = 6
    colors = [1,2,3,4,5,7,8,9]
    for _ in range(rng.randint(5, max(7, h*w//4))):

            g[r][c] = rng.choice(colors)
